bear_case.title: The revenue gap
bear_case.description: Hyperscalers are on pace to deploy ~$660–690B of capex in 2026 against ~$51B of direct AI revenue generated — roughly a 10:1 ratio, versus 2.4:1 when cloud computing was at a similar adoption stage in 2011. The BIS's 2026 Annual Report names an AI-capex bust as one of its top three risks to global financial stability.

bear_case.title: Capex now punished, not rewarded
bear_case.description: Alphabet beat Q2 revenue estimates but fell >7% — its worst day in over a year — after raising 2026 capex guidance to $195–205B; the Magnificent Seven lost 5.7% in a single week as investors stopped rewarding spending increases and started punishing them.

bear_case.title: Off-balance-sheet obligations
bear_case.description: Moody's flags ~$662B of signed-but-not-commenced data-center lease commitments sitting off hyperscaler balance sheets.

bear_case.title: Circular financing
bear_case.description: Interlocking vendor-equity stakes and take-or-pay compute deals among NVIDIA, Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic, Oracle and CoreWeave — echoing the Lucent/Nortel vendor-financing dynamics of 1999–2001 — make end-demand look larger and more independent than it is. Analysts now peg the web of circular deals at over $800B, and the BIS flags a "circular financing collapse" as a top-three global financial-stability risk.

bear_case.title: Depreciation clock
bear_case.description: Hyperscalers depreciate AI hardware over 5–6 years, but bears (Michael Burry among them) argue the chips' real economic life is closer to 1–3 years — an estimated ~$176B understatement of depreciation across 2026–2028 that flatters reported earnings. The first defaults could surface in 2027–2028 as initial lease terms come up for renewal.

bear_case.title: Concentration everywhere
bear_case.description: AI is simultaneously the market's largest index weight, VC's largest allocation (86% of $412.7B H1 2026 US venture funding), and this hub's connective thread — a drawdown would hit robotics, nuclear, storage, and quantum sentiment at once.

catalysts.title: TSMC results validate the capex thesis

catalysts.title: Big Tech earnings week tests the AI trade
catalysts.description: Microsoft and Meta report Jul 29, Amazon Jul 30; 175 S&P 500 companies report overall. Last week the Magnificent Seven fell 5.7% on AI-spending anxiety — a reversal from the market previously rewarding capex increases.

catalysts.title: Waymo under regulatory scrutiny
catalysts.description: NHTSA and NTSB have opened investigations after Waymo vehicles illegally passed a school bus in Texas and a robotaxi struck a child near a Santa Monica elementary school.
